summary: A Fire 2 assignment at Cottonwood Road and Watts Drive drew multiple engines and a battalion chief. Additional callers reported smoke in the area, which crews confirmed was the same incident.
A Fire 2 assignment was ordered for a fire outside the Golden West Casino on South Union Avenue, with multiple engines, a rescue and a battalion chief responding.
Officers were asked to respond to a reported stabbing that had just occurred; a nearby unit was requested for the call.
A possible domestic violence call on Polo Drive after a report that a man shoved his wife to the floor. Additional callers were being located.
A possible domestic situation in which a girlfriend was heard screaming and furniture was being thrown around.
Report of people believed to be setting each other's camps on fire in a homeless encampment; responders were asked to treat it as a fire only if flames were seen.
Welfare check on a toddler, about 2 to 3 years old, who was seen running in and out of a business while accompanied by three men holding fishing poles.
Disturbance call involving an ex-boyfriend at a residence on Shannon Drive, with a young child present.
Priority call for an active fight involving multiple subjects on El Rancho Drive.
A vehicle was reported stopped in the middle of the roadway on White Street.
A silver Hyundai was reported driving northbound on Highway 5; the driver was said to be known to the reporting party.
Medical aid at a Walmart pharmacy on Tucker Road.
Medical aid for difficulty breathing on 8th Street.
An in-progress call at a California Avenue business; a man was reported running from the scene toward a black Audi.
Report at a busy intersection on Pittsfield Street; the caller was unable to provide suspect information.
Medical aid for a reported overdose; the patient was not violent and no weapon was involved.
